title: Sindarin
description: Fictional language in the fantasy works of J. R. R. Tolkien
extract: Sindarin is one of the constructed languages devised by J. R. R. Tolkien for use in his fantasy stories set in Arda, primarily in Middle-earth. Sindarin is one of the many languages spoken by the Elves.
